_doc: J31: the versions the review viewer and the in-game host (J30) build from. viewer/core/fetch_sources.py fetches each by commit or sha256; nothing is vendored. Change a pin only with a reason in the job report.

rmlui.why: Empire's shipped version (empire-remastered rml_mod/src/CMakeLists.txt, LEGAL_NOTES A1)

freetype.why: Empire's FreeType (same CMakeLists), TTF only, no optional dependencies

lua.why: the engine's Lua (exe string 'Lua 5.1 Copyright (C) 1994-2006'); the same tarball as proxy/tools/fetch_lua.py (tests/test_viewer.py checks they agree); built with float lua_Number

emsdk_image.why: official Emscripten image (emcc 4.0.10, cmake 3.22, node 22); keeps Emscripten off the PC (D30, D31)

stb_image.why: PNG and JPEG decoding for art (the review artifact serves web image types only, not .tga); the same commit as Empire's rml_mod

stb_image_write.why: J30: the in-game host's lossless backbuffer dump (ctl ui dump) writes PNG; the same stb commit as stb_image
